# Strict schemas and provider error preservation — 2026-11-13

Base revision `f304747` with uncommitted PY-057 fixes. Luna implemented; Sol 6.1 High reviewed and independently verified. **One of at most five authorized paid rounds used; stopped after scoped technical verification passed.** No per-request retries, semantic judge, commit or push.

## Changes

- The strict JSON-schema path normalizes schemas with LangChain strict conversion before SDK binding. Nested nullable fields are included in `required`. Decoded output is validated again with the original Pydantic DTO; raw responses, parse errors and observation/source-ID validators remain effective. Parser tool-calling behavior is unchanged.
- Generation and owning-stage telemetry preserve bounded, redacted provider status/code/message/provider/raw details, including nested error objects. Request headers/credentials are excluded.
- HTTP evaluation capture preserves non-JSON failure status/body rather than replacing the original HTTP failure with JSONDecodeError.

Local verification: **223 passed / 5 opt-in skipped**, disposable Testcontainers; Ruff and mypy **104 files** passed. Sol independently passed **186 unit tests** and actual offline SDK/schema/callback probes. Offline tests use MockTransport, including real SDK BadRequestResponseError and in-memory trace export; they make no inference calls.

## Paid verification, round 1/5

Repeated Q02/Q04/Q07/Q08 once on the same fifteen fixture/manifest hashes and eleven-stone corpus, real local embeddings, same limits and actual model routing as PY-055: Luna parsing/audit/selection/answer, Terra candidate/reference evidence. The experiment-only harness is [archived](PY-057-evidence-model-harness.py.txt); HTTP shared model settings name Luna, while `experiment.actual_stage_models` and actual generation telemetry record the Terra override.

| Measure | PY-055 before | PY-057 round 1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HTTP | 2 × 200, 2 × 500 | 4 × 200 |
| Provider-error generations | 3 (two Terra, one Luna) | 0 |
| Completed Terra evidence outputs | 0 | 1 (Q02) |
| Execution integrity | 0 pass / 2 fail / 2 unknown | 1 pass / 3 fail |
| Semantic answer-quality judge | Disabled | Disabled |

The live capture test passed. **This is not four successful recommendations.**

- **Q02:** Luna audit complete, without redundant availability request. Actual Terra call successfully returns three character findings with explicit nullable observation IDs; original `CandidateEvidence` validation passes. Madame Obsidian recommended and Sir Pebble conditional, with availability verified and pair conditions shown.
- **Q04:** audit incomplete. Candidate type and both agreement atoms survive; audit flags invented hard compatibility and the quiet-home classification. No candidate evidence/decision. These are semantic issues; no schema/provider failure.
- **Q07:** audit catches candidate type misclassified as a compatibility mandate and absent from candidate_type. No Terra assessment.
- **Q08:** audit catches non-applicability of granite agreements encoded as explicit false values. No Terra assessment.

All four Luna grounding outputs revalidate against the original `GroundingResponse`. All **11 generation observations** are successful: ten Luna, one Terra. Schema/DTO and source binding checks are preserved. A single completed Terra call does not establish broad evidence accuracy or model superiority; the historical raw provider bodies remain unavailable, so the specific cause of each old refusal is not retroactively proven.

## Stop decision and limits

Sol reviewed the live records and found no new strict-schema/provider/typed-contract defect requiring a repair/repeat cycle. The remaining semantic failures existed before this task. They remain visible; the audit was not weakened, malformed parses were not silently repaired, and questions/expected outcomes were not changed to force success. Stop after **1/5 rounds**, with four scenario attempts total. Provider-error logging is validated offline; this live run could not exercise it because no provider error occurred.

Reported generation cost **$0.010772935**; four traces, eleven generations, all cost fields present. This is reported telemetry, not independent billing reconciliation.
